assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission using the submitted provisional boundaries and design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: All submitted scope and key-area polygons are repository provisional constraints, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: Area-derived design proportions, node placement, diagrams and phasing must be recalculated after cleared official geometry is supplied.

assumptions.statement: The Loop, crossings, stations, building actions, municipal capacity and event operations are conceptual suggestions for professional teams to deepen.
assumptions.impact: They create no land, investment, approval, demolition, engineering or operating commitment.
